profiles.scope: Cost-driven actual C state transitions; numerical scenarios, not target WCET.

dynamic_costs.SPI_IRQ: IRQ_FIRST per initial port launch, IRQ_START per subsequent launch, IRQ_COMPLETE per wire completion
dynamic_costs.TICK_IRQ: TICK0/TICK1 per 100Hz core interrupt; one tick/IRQ; same-task reselection, plus at most one peer kernel increment and one peer scheduler section of lock wait

scope_limits: Fixed costs mix alpha=1.1 instruction envelopes and unmeasured allocated budgets; none are target WCET.
Only reception loop is timed; startup/shutdown/fault handling and other application/PHY tasks are outside the model.
10,000/20,000 cycle slice admission bounds are assumptions, not measured bounds.
Ideal RF ABI and exact common clock; 80MHz SPI with immediate SDK publication after completion IRQ.
1024/2048/3072 preparation budgets are model variants; production remains 1024. Per-poll cap wrapper is modeled inside RF budgets, not independently instruction-counted.
Operation cost placement is a discretization, not instruction-level interleaving; fixed core0 priority for simultaneous events.
No inherited U, differential scans, or separate API20us term is added. Costs are charged once at the named boundary.

lock_wait_model.conditions: Frozen two-task receiver. Only peer tick/scheduler uses kernel lock and only peer reset uses WDT lock during receiving; no higher-level IRQ extension. Competitor full function costs bound their own critical sections in the same instruction model. Each peer can arrive at most once in the modeled wait (10ms/2.5s periods).
